name: Isa Khan
role: Leader of the Bhati resistance and central Baro-Bhuyans figure
contribution: He coordinated regional chiefs in Bhati and built riverine military defenses that repeatedly challenged Mughal expansion.
context: Active in the late-16th-century transition after Rajmahal, he led confederate-style resistance in eastern Bengal.
impact: He became the most enduring symbol of Baro-Bhuyans autonomy in Bengal historical memory.
highlight: The best-known strategist of Bhati's anti-imperial river resistance.
seoTitle: Isa Khan: Leader of Bhati Resistance
seoDescription: Explore Isa Khan's riverine resistance, Baro-Bhuyans leadership, and conflicts with Mughal expansion in Bengal.
shortAnswer: Isa Khan was the leading Baro-Bhuyans chief who organized river-based resistance in Bhati against Mughal expansion.
